recent_excerpts: Chen Yixin, head of China's Ministry of State Security, named OpenAI's GPT-5.5-Cyber and Anthropic's Claude Mythos as signs of a 'disruptive upgrade' in offensive cyber capability.
Anthropic disrupted Midnight Blizzard (APT29) and a Chinese university group abusing Claude against 20+ government, defense and drone-supply targets, publishing IOCs for defenders.
99% of SOCs see AI-driven IR gains despite 96% at early maturity; 82% now platform-oriented. But AI infrastructure is deployed faster than secured, creating new attack surface.
